summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Betterware de México, S.A.P.I. de C.V., a foreign private issuer, reporting the minutes of its General Ordinary Shareholders Meeting held on April 30, 2026. The meeting addressed routine agenda items such as the presentation and approval of the Board of Directors' annual report for fiscal year 2025, as required under Mexican corporate law. No special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is mentioned. The filing is a routine current report of a shareholder meeting and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
